# Robust approach to cointegration/pairs trading

## Description

Proposed robust approach to cointegration/pairs trading: Test related securities for a stable long-run relationship and consider trades when the estimated spread deviates from its equilibrium, with safeguards for relationship breakdown. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
